resources.string: Android uses the official WireGuard tunnel library and userspace backend. The library license and upstream source references are included with this app.
Optional WireGuard connection and torrent protection.
Off by default. Import a connection profile before enabling.
VPN support is not available on this device yet.
Import a WireGuard connection profile first.
Approve the system VPN permission on Android, or administrator permission on Windows.
Select a .conf file from a VPN provider that supports torrents.
Downloads pause and internet access remains blocked until reconnecting or turning protection off.
VPN covers this device’s internet traffic. Protection can block internet access in other apps too. Local network devices may become unavailable.

Nuvio keeps its own torrents on the VPN network. For additional protection of other apps, enable Always-on VPN and Block connections without VPN in Android settings, if available. Turn those options off before disabling VPN here. Some TVs do not provide these system controls.
Use your provider’s WireGuard settings when a file picker is unavailable on TV. Keys stay on this device. The server and DNS must use numeric IP addresses.
When VPN is enabled, torrents must wait for a protected connection. VPN does not scan files for malware or guarantee anonymity. A VPN server or provider profile is required.
Experimental feature. Real-server and connection-failure validation must be completed before a public release.
Downloads and torrent playback will stop first. If you start them again, your normal internet connection will be used. They will not restart automatically.
The saved profile will be deleted. Torrents will pause. Protection stays on if it was enabled.
This preview requires numeric IP addresses for the server and DNS. Hostnames are not supported yet.
The torrent engine has not stopped. Protection will not be removed. Pause downloads and retry.
This preview requires a full-tunnel WireGuard profile.
Previous VPN protection is still active. Use the local recovery tool before reinstalling.
VPN is configured for another Windows user on this computer.
The operation could not be completed. If VPN is enabled, torrents remain blocked. Check the profile and VPN component.
VPN connection is required. Connect from Network and VPN settings, then retry.
Windows VPN uses the official WireGuard client and wg tools. Component licenses and source references are included in the VPN runtime.
